R0.name: Atrium
R0.description: The starting chamber. Faint light filters through dusty skylights. A brass key rests on a pedestal.

R1.name: Gallery
R1.description: Paintings line the walls, each depicting a strange ritual. A wooden stick leans against the far wall.

R2.name: Archive
R2.description: Rows of cabinets hold ancient records. A glyph terminal glows in the corner — it can decode glyphs into keys.

R3.name: Workshop
R3.description: A crafting bench dominates the centre. A rock sits beneath the bench.

R4.name: Conservatory
R4.description: Glass panels reveal a starlit courtyard. An unlit torch and a flask of oil sit on a shelf.

R5.name: Antechamber
R5.description: The final corridor before the exit. The air is charged with energy.

R6.name: Mirror Hall
R6.description: Reflections multiply infinitely. A glowing wormhole pad pulses on the floor. A cursed idol rests on a plinth — handle with care.

R7.name: Exit
R7.description: Freedom. The escape room is solved.

exit_door.note: Also blocked if player holds cursed_idol unless epoch_phase is eclipse
